ActivityLogDetails.description: The details related to the processing of an Activity

id.description: The Id of the Activity Log entry.

activityId.description: The activity Id that this entry refers to.

generator.description: The identity of the Activity's generator.

dateCreated.description: The creation date of this object.

dateModified.description: The last update date of this object.

ActivityLogEntry.description: The details related to the processing of an Activity

tasks.description: The tasks that have to be run to process the Activity.

anyOf.description: Pending: Activity Processing has not started yet.
Completed: Activity processing completed without error.
Error: Activity processing cannot be performed and marked as in error. (Depends on application).
Transient state. The background tasks associated with the activity are still being registered.

ActivityTaskEntry.description: Denotes a task associated with a Dataspace App

result.description: The result of the task processing, if completed.

CompleteTransferResponse.description: Transfer Process (DSP compliant) with state COMPLETED, or error.

DataAssetItemList.description:
Interface describing a list of entities that are within a Data Asset.
Pagination is handled via HTTP Link headers.

consumerPid.description:
The consumer Process ID from the DSP Transfer Process.
Mandatory - used to determine the Dataset, Distribution, and Agreement.
The datasetId is resolved from the Transfer Process using this ID.

DataAssetQueryRequest.description: Request body containing the data asset and query criteria.

id.description:
Optional explicit id for the stored dataset record. If omitted, the
Control Plane derives the id from `dataset["@id"]` if present, or
generates a UUID otherwise. The resolved id is returned via the
`Location` response header.

appId.description:
The dataspace app this dataset belongs to. Matches the app's
registered name in `DataspaceAppFactory` (typically the app's URI).

cursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page if more entries exist.

appId.description:
The dataspace app this dataset belongs to. May change appId on
update if the tenant wants to retarget the dataset.

message.description: The message for the error as an i18n key.

properties.description: Any additional information for the error.

stack.description: The stack trace for the error.

FilteringQuery.description: A query over a data asset that to be processed by a Dataspace Data Plane App.

jsonLdContext.description: The JSON-LD context to be applied over the query terms.

GetTransferProcessResponse.description: Transfer Process (DSP compliant) with current state, or error.

Health.description: Provides health information for a component.

description.description: The description of the component as an i18n key.

isChild.description: Whether this entry is a child of another entry, the parent entry will report the overall status of the component.

details.description: The details for the status if there are further details to provide as an i18n key.

properties.description: Properties to substitute in the i18n key for the details.

HealthStatus.description: The health status of the component.

notFoundId.description: The id if the item that was not found.

NotFoundResponse.description: The body which contains the error.

PartialDatasetRecord.description: Stored partial dataset record returned by the Control Plane's dataset CRUD surface.

id.description: The stored dataset id (matches the dataset's JSON-LD `@id`).

appId.description: The dataspace app this dataset belongs to.

RequestTransferResponse.description: Transfer Process (DSP compliant) with state REQUESTED, or error.

ServerLivezResponse.description: The livez information for the server.

ServerReadyzResponse.description: The readyz information for the server.

StartTransferResponse.description: Transfer Start Message (DSP compliant) with dataAddress for PULL transfers, or error.

SuspendTransferResponse.description: Transfer Process (DSP compliant) with state SUSPENDED, or error.

TerminateTransferResponse.description: Transfer Process (DSP compliant) with state TERMINATED, or error.
